assessment_scope: Read-only source and evidence audit, focused local tests, authenticated GitHub metadata read, and supported local development-status query. No live Ubuntu action, provider dispatch, service restart, product-code edit or deployment.

source.concurrent_change_observed: tests/settings-redesign.test.js became modified during the audit; no product files were edited by this audit.
source.proof_qualification: Focused tests exercised the contemporaneous dirty worktree, not an immutable release or a clean-HEAD build. Source, loaded runtime, and remote main must not be conflated.

focused_tests.proof_level: Focused store, real temporary file/Git service, and mocked IPC/DOM behavior; not native Electron/live MCP end-to-end proof.
focused_tests.additional_reproduction: In-memory approval store confirms patchApprovals uses relative path alone and has no workspace parameter.
focused_tests.backend_test_limitation: Python backend suite not executed: managed Python has no pytest and importing Runtime fails because PyJWT (jwt) is unavailable. This is an audit-environment dependency gap, not a demonstrated product regression.

local_runtime_probe.interpretation: A Recovery Host is reachable, but this development checkout is not matched to its installation. This does not prove the packaged product or Ubuntu service is down; it prevents a current-source readiness claim.

canonical_local_ledger.access: SQLite mode=ro, query_only=ON, explicit read transaction; no updates or migrations

nonempty_outcome_receipts.qualification: Stored historical records; hash-chain validity, external host-turn authority, natural-cohort eligibility and full causal joins were not independently audited. Receipt events have empty direct run_id/wave_id; inspect other lineage events before judging linkage.

canonical_local_ledger.qualification: This is the local ledger only, not all archived or Ubuntu evidence and not necessarily the serving ledger. Three of 42 must not be presented as a Verified Outcome Rate. Empty Goal tables do not prove the feature was never used elsewhere. Historical active RUN labels do not prove live processes.

historical_remote_execution_evidence.qualification: Retained aggregate receipt inspected, not replayed or fully re-audited against every raw source. It records historical execution on another candidate, not current-HEAD operation or autonomous Goal outcome.

key_findings.finding: Recipe Jobs have real exec_command/command_control IPC plumbing
Work Hub request composer, queue, schedules and Goal preparation are not a runtime AI dispatcher
Patch-review markers have no workspace identity and are advisory, not runtime grants
Command-output references explicitly have durability=process_runtime and restart_safe=false
Existing Goal episode parent and child mechanisms are substantial, but use bounded RUN-like limits rather than the whole planned aggregate parent budget
Current default local Windows execution is host-user execution, not OS isolation
key_findings.level: maintained source-state contract; loaded mode unverified

roadmap.goal: Reconcile source, installation and evidence identity without resetting concurrent work
roadmap.gate: One intended installation and exact target are identified; an authorized read-only canary returns matching workspace/source and receipt; state mismatch is explained.

roadmap.goal: Complete one supported end-to-end Work Hub workflow
roadmap.gate: Request accepted by a real supported channel with durable ID; scoped edit/diff/proof/artifact and review are traced; local UI markers cannot claim runtime authority; native Electron flow passes.

roadmap.goal: Prove bounded background continuation using existing modules
roadmap.gate: Response-end survival, FAIL-to-next-action dispatch, STOP/revoke, unknown-effect reconciliation and budget preservation are demonstrated; technical review and user outcome remain separate.
Every case retains failures, reopens, oracle/source identity and missingness; baseline comparisons are descriptive, not causal claims from a tiny cohort.

roadmap.goal: Expand only where measured bottlenecks justify it
roadmap.gate: Multi-Goal, multi-machine or domain adapters improve accepted outcomes under the same safety and quality floors.

changes_performed: Only audit deliverables and a project work-log entry; no product source, canonical evidence, services, grants, Git commits, pushes, releases or deployments were changed.
